ValidationRule.description: 29T: at least one weekday, every 1 to 52 weeks, each shift ends after it starts, the end date is not before the start date, at least one volunteer. Holds with automation off.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: OR( ISBLANK(Weekdays__c), ISBLANK(Every_N_Weeks__c), Every_N_Weeks__c < 1, Every_N_Weeks__c > 52, AND( NOT(ISBLANK(Start_Time__c)), NOT(ISBLANK(End_Time__c)), End_Time__c <= Start_Time__c ), AND( NOT(ISBLANK(End_Date__c)), NOT(ISBLANK(Start_Date__c)), End_Date__c < Start_Date__c ), ISBLANK(Volunteers_Needed__c), Volunteers_Needed__c < 1 )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Check the schedule: pick at least one weekday, repeat every 1 to 52 weeks, end each shift after it starts, keep the end date on or after the start date, and ask for at least one volunteer.
